W.note: Full shopping loop (search, category chips, sort, cart drawer with steppers, totals, free-shipping hint, checkout, toast) in a restrained layout, though the initials placeholder tiles (two of them both reading WC) and roomy card bodies make it less dense and less specific than it could be.

X.note: Tight four-column grid with bespoke line-drawn product art and inline minus/count/plus steppers is the most compact and restrained, but product names truncate with ellipses on desktop and there is no bag review or checkout beyond a summary line.

Y.note: Desktop buttons and steppers wrap their labels onto two lines ('Add to / bag', '1 in / bag') and several product names truncate, and the bag is only a count pill with a footer with no cart review or checkout.

Z.note: Full cart drawer with quantity controls, totals and checkout is strong, but emoji as product imagery (a couch for a blanket, a pouring glyph for a bottle) reads dated and decorative and weakens the minimal, modern brief.
